Package com.ceichhorst.reservation.entity

Class Reservation

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ceichhorst.reservation.entity.Reservation
  • @Entity
public class Reservation
extends Object
    Entity representing a reservation made by a customer for a specific ServiceInstance.

    This class maps to the reservation table in the reservation_platform database and captures all relevant details about a reservation, including customer information, party size, dietary restrictions, and reservation status.

    Each reservation is associated with exactly one service instance, but a service instance may have multiple reservations.
